summary: Prototype rules passed 22 emulator groups and live unauthorized-request checks. Live profiles are the authority; requested roles never grant privileges. Remaining operational requirements are documented.

findings.issue: Disabling or deleting Firebase Auth alone does not immediately invalidate an already-issued token. Rules cannot query the Auth directory.
findings.recommendation: Revoke or delete the users profile before disabling/deleting Auth so current Firestore authorization is removed immediately. Follow the owner procedure.

findings.issue: Approved members can read all approved profiles/emails and portal attendance, as requested; collection listeners are unpaginated for the club-sized dataset.
findings.recommendation: Keep approvals intentional. Reassess field visibility, session query limits and pagination if the club or privacy requirements grow.
